user.title: Trelleborg Kretslopp och Vatten
user.description: Enter the property address, e.g. "Östergatan 42 ANDERSLÖV". Then add the bins in your subscription.

bin.title: Bin {count}
bin.description: Enter when the bin is emptied. Values are prefilled from Trelleborg's standard subscriptions and can be changed.

data_description.reference_date: Pick any day the bin is emptied (e.g. the last or next collection). Weekday and rhythm are derived from it.
data_description.interval_weeks: Weeks between collections, e.g. 2 for every other week or 4 for every fourth week.
data_description.season_start_week: Leave empty if the bin is collected all year. Garden waste in Trelleborg: weeks 12–47.
data_description.season_end_week: Leave empty if the bin is collected all year. Garden waste in Trelleborg: weeks 12–47.
data_description.exclude_dates: Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) when the regular collection does not happen, e.g. holidays. Comma separated.
data_description.extra_dates: Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) for extra or moved collections. Comma separated.

error.invalid_date_list: Enter dates as YYYY-MM-DD separated by commas.
error.season_incomplete: Enter both start and end week for the season, or leave both empty.
